issues: The Lord’s words in Ether 4:6–7 are quoted accurately, but the summary and explicit facts identify the speaker as Jesus Christ; verse 6 says only “the Lord,” and verse 7 names Jesus Christ. This is plausible across the passage but not explicit for verse 6.
The claim that addressed people “become clean before him” is supported in substance by the verse’s phrase “clean before the Lord”; there is no described visual setting or audience.

The scene correctly treats the heavens, earthquake, and fire as declarations rather than present events. The summary’s “Jesus Christ warns” is supported by the surrounding direct speech, though the verse 8 introduction itself uses “he.”
“People will know at the last day that he speaks” accurately summarizes the text; the actual quotation given is a contiguous excerpt.
